basic_details.job_title: LITU Finance & Accounts Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Laxminarayan Innovation Technological University (LITU), Nagpur has invited applications for one Open category post of Finance & Accounts Officer at pay Level S-29 (Rs.1,31,100 – 2,16,600). The application must be posted to the Registrar at Bharat Nagar, Amravati Road, Nagpur-440033 and must reach by 5:00 p.m. on 1 December 2026. Applications received by email, fax or any other digital mode are not entertained.

qualification.details: Qualification and experience: Chartered Accountant or a Cost Accountant, with professional experience of not less than 5 years. Age: not less than 45 years on the date of application. The age column of the application form asks for age as on 30 November 2026. No upper age limit and no age relaxation are printed in the notice. Language: proficiency in the Marathi language is essential. Reserved category candidates domiciled outside the State of Maharashtra are treated as OPEN category candidates. Qualifications, experience, age and all other eligibility conditions must be fulfilled as on the last date for making the application. Pay: besides the pay, the post carries other usual allowances and benefits as admissible under state government rules in force from time to time. | The eligibility criteria and pay scale are as prescribed in the Laxminarayan Innovation Technological University Act, read with Maharashtra State Government (Department of Higher & Technical Education) Resolution No. Sankirn – 1123/Pr. Kr. 150/Vishi-1, dated 10 July 2025. | The appointment is for a term of five years OR till the officer attains the age of superannuation, whichever is earlier. A defined contribution pension scheme, under the Government Resolution dated 31 October 2005, applies to government servants recruited on or after 1 November 2005, and the notice says the same applies to employees of this University.

selection_process: The appointment is based on the recommendation of a selection committee constituted as per the LITU Act (the Laxminarayan Innovation Technological University Act 2023). The notice says the information in the form is used to decide the eligibility and suitability of candidates for being called for the interview. Candidates must produce all original documents for verification at the time of the interview. No correspondence is made with applicants who are not short-listed or not called for an interview. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: About LITU
content_sections.text: Laxminarayan Innovation Technological University is in Nagpur. Its letterhead says it was established by the Government of Maharashtra Act XLI, 2023, and was formerly known as Laxminarayan Institute of Technology, Nagpur. The post is a university post, and the notice is signed by the Registrar.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the duly completed application in the prescribed format, on A-4 size paper, in a cloth-lined envelope. The notice names the submission mode only as "the prescribed mode". Open Category: Rs. 1,000/- SC/ST/VJ(A)/NT(B/C/D)/OBC and other Reserved Categories: Rs. 600/- The payment receipt must be attached to the application form. The notice prints these bank details: Indian Overseas Bank, Branch Pande Layout, Nagpur, Account No. 242101029082023, IFSC Code IOBA0002421. The application form calls the fee non-refundable and has a section for the transaction ID, date and amount.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Qualification and experience: Chartered Accountant or a Cost Accountant, with professional experience of not less than 5 years. Age: not less than 45 years on the date of application. The age column of the application form asks for age as on 30 November 2026. No upper age limit and no age relaxation are printed in the notice. Language: proficiency in the Marathi language is essential. Reserved category candidates domiciled outside the State of Maharashtra are treated as OPEN category candidates. Qualifications, experience, age and all other eligibility conditions must be fulfilled as on the last date for making the application. Pay: besides the pay, the post carries other usual allowances and benefits as admissible under state government rules in force from time to time. The eligibility criteria and pay scale are as prescribed in the Laxminarayan Innovation Technological University Act, read with Maharashtra State Government (Department of Higher & Technical Education) Resolution No. Sankirn – 1123/Pr. Kr. 150/Vishi-1, dated 10 July 2025. The appointment is for a term of five years OR till the officer attains the age of superannuation, whichever is earlier. A defined contribution pension scheme, under the Government Resolution dated 31 October 2005, applies to government servants recruited on or after 1 November 2005, and the notice says the same applies to employees of this University.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly completed application form, with a passport-size colour photograph pasted (not stapled or pinned) in the space at the top right, attested by the applicant, in at least two sets of the application forms. Self-attested copies of certificates/testimonials in TEN SETS. The enclosure serial number must be written in the respective column of the form, and information in a certificate is not considered unless it is claimed in the form. Payment receipt of the registration fee. Bio-data. Duly filled "Proforma-A", supplied with the application form. Failure to submit it makes the application liable for rejection. Declaration-II of the application form, on the small family rule (Maharashtra Notification No. SRV.2000/CR/(17/2000) XII, dated 28 March 2005). Self-attested copies of the Caste certificate, Caste Validity certificate and Non-creamy layer certificate, wherever applicable. For in-service candidates: the form signed and forwarded by the present employer (Endorsement by the Employer is part of the form). The application form also asks for details of two referees, professional experience, academic distinctions, memberships of professional bodies and competence in computer applications.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The appointment is based on the recommendation of a selection committee constituted as per the LITU Act (the Laxminarayan Innovation Technological University Act 2023). The notice says the information in the form is used to decide the eligibility and suitability of candidates for being called for the interview. Candidates must produce all original documents for verification at the time of the interview. No correspondence is made with applicants who are not short-listed or not called for an interview. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in LITU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for the post of Finance & Accounts Officer, in the Open category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the LITU Finance & Accounts Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date is 1 December 2026, up to 5:00 p.m. Applications received after the prescribed last date and time are rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the LITU Finance & Accounts Officer post?
faq.answer: The candidate must be a Chartered Accountant or a Cost Accountant, with professional experience of not less than 5 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for LITU Finance & Accounts Officer?
faq.answer: The age must be not less than 45 years on the date of application. The notice prints no upper age limit.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the LITU Finance & Accounts Officer?
faq.answer: The pay is Level S-29, Rs.1,31,100 – 2,16,600/-, along with other usual allowances and benefits as admissible under state government rules in force from time to time.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for LITU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The registration fee is Rs. 1,000/- for the Open Category and Rs. 600/- for SC/ST/VJ(A)/NT(B/C/D)/OBC and other Reserved Categories. The payment receipt must be attached to the form.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the LITU Finance & Accounts Officer post?
faq.answer: Send the completed form with the enclosures in a cloth-lined envelope to The Registrar, Laxminarayan Innovation Technological University, Bharat Nagar, Amravati Road, Nagpur-440033. Write the Advertisement No., Name of the Post and Category on the envelope.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply by email for the LITU post?
faq.answer: No. The notice says applications received by email, fax or any other digital mode will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q9. How is the Finance & Accounts Officer selected?
faq.answer: Appointment is based on the recommendation of a selection committee constituted as per the LITU Act. Applicants may be called for an interview, where original documents are verified.

faq.question: Q10. Is the LITU Finance & Accounts Officer post permanent?
faq.answer: The appointment is for a term of five years OR till the officer attains the age of superannuation, whichever is earlier.
